Before you begin

Warm-up

  1. What do you often say when you meet someone new?

  2. What do you like doing in your free time?

  3. What place do you like to visit?

Typing practice

Type the text exactly. Timer starts with your first key.

Text to type: Ken is from Osaka, Japan. He lives in Osaka with his wife. He works at a small camera shop. His week is often busy. These first lines give clear facts about Ken’s daily life. The words from and lives have different jobs. From tells us his home city and country. Lives tells us where his home is now. Here, both places are Osaka. The next lines tell us about his work and his busy week.

Typing practice

Type the text exactly. Timer starts with your first key.

Text to type: When he has free time, he likes walking. He also likes taking photos, because the streets are quiet. Free time is time away from work and other things that must be done. Ken names two things he likes. They are walking and taking photos. The word because gives a reason. Ken enjoys taking photos when the streets are quiet. This small detail helps us understand what he likes about this time.

Typing practice

Type the text exactly. Timer starts with your first key.

Text to type: On weekends, he usually walks and drinks coffee. Sometimes he goes to a park with his wife. His favorite place is Osaka Castle park, because the walk is easy and the trees are nice. This part tells us about regular weekend activities. Usually shows something that happens on many weekends. Sometimes shows something that happens, but not every weekend. Ken also names one favorite place. Again, because introduces his reasons. The easy walk and nice trees make the park special to him.

Typing practice

Type the text exactly. Timer starts with your first key.

Text to type: He likes old cameras. He started to like them because his father had one. These days, he takes photos of the river. This part connects the past with the present. Ken’s father had an old camera, and this was the start of Ken’s interest. These days moves the reading to his life now. He now uses his interest by taking river photos. The three sentences form a simple path from his father’s camera to an activity that Ken does now.

Typing practice

Type the text exactly. Timer starts with your first key.

Text to type: Later, he wants to visit Kyoto for a weekend. One thing he wants to try is a night photo class. He thinks it would be fun because city lights look different at night. Now the reading moves from Ken’s present life to his future plans. Later shows that the visit is not happening now. Wants to try introduces a new activity. Ken also gives a reason for his choice. Night changes how city lights look, so a night class may give him a new way to take photos.

Typing practice

Type the text exactly. Timer starts with your first key.

Text to type: Now make the talk your own. Each blank needs a true detail about you. Start with your name and home. Then add work, free time, weekends, a favorite place, an interest, and a future plan. The lines with because ask for reasons. Reasons help the listener understand your choices. You can complete all the lines, or choose the lines that share the clearest picture of your life. Hi! My name is ________. I am from ________, Japan. I live in ________ with ________. I am a ________ / I work at ________. I usually have a busy week, but when I have free time, I like ________. I also enjoy ________ because ________. On weekends, I usually ________. Sometimes I go to ________ with ________. My favorite place is ________ because ________. I am interested in ________. I became interested in it because ________. Recently, I have been ________. In the future, I would like to ________. One thing I want to learn or try is ________. I think it would be interesting because ________.
